summary.zh: 接入 PayPal 结账、订阅与退款流程
summary.en: Add PayPal checkout, subscriptions, and refunds to your app

description.zh: 覆盖 PayPal 快捷结账、订阅扣款、退款和 webhook 通知的接入方式，并给出前端按钮与后端订单校验的示例。适合在电商或 SaaS 项目中新增 PayPal 支付选项时使用。实际联调需要 PayPal 开发者账号和 sandbox 凭据，并保持网络可访问 PayPal 接口。
description.en: Adds PayPal express checkout, subscriptions, refunds, and webhooks, with front-end and server-side examples. Use it when adding PayPal to a shop or SaaS plan; testing needs sandbox credentials and network access.
